review_basis: Frozen report prose, extracted elements, formal plan and generated P/I/V; DeepSeek generation output was not treated as ground truth.

ratings.reason: progress_or_liveness is suitable, but the plan combines pre-bonding zero-share/pair-absent conditions with the post-bonding AMM-trading-failure impact, crossing two alternative report branches.
The report's attack condition is a donated nonzero balance with no sweep path, but the formal relation uses vault_balance == 0 and therefore generates a violation outside the reported scenario.

The temporal invariant and direct violation are faithful. One selected P source only says EntryPoint checks validity, yet its predicate is valid_period_expired, so source-to-P attribution is overclaimed.

The unauthorized-drain relation is captured, but three intent-derived authorization booleans are ORed together; the report specifically requires delegatecall context, so the synthesized I is weaker than the narrow stated intent.
The readiness response semantically says ready with all four dimensions present, but one extra response field caused deterministic schema rejection before extraction.

summary.interpretation: Small provisional artifact review, not population accuracy and not an expert gold standard.
